sections.name: Intro Riff
sections.description: Opening guitar riff establishing the E major tonality with tight downstroke power chords

riffAnalysis.fretPositions: Open position E5 and 5th/7th fret power chords
riffAnalysis.rhythmPattern: Driving half-note strums with percussive attack
riffAnalysis.musicalFunction: Establishes key and Australian rock feel

notes: Start with strong open E5 power chord attack (0.6 2.5 2.4)
Move smoothly up to 5th fret A5 (5.6 7.5 7.4) and 7th fret B5 (7.6 9.5 9.4)
Build energy for the explosive verse entry
sections.exerciseLabel: Iconic Australian Pub Rock Downstroke Riff

sections.name: Verse
sections.description: Main verse progression with E-A-E-B-E pattern using classic Australian rock rhythm

riffAnalysis.technique: Power chord progression with palm muting
riffAnalysis.rhythmPattern: Driving rhythm strums with dynamic palm muting

notes: Keep strumming consistent and driving throughout
Use palm muting for verse dynamic control
Focus on clean chord transitions between E5, A5, and B5

sections.name: Chorus
sections.description: Main chorus with full open chord voicings for bigger sound and energy

riffAnalysis.technique: Full open and barre chord voicings
riffAnalysis.musicalFunction: Creates dynamic lift and energy for chorus

notes: Open up the sound without palm muting for maximum chorus energy
Emphasize the downbeats with full 6-string chord resonance
Support John Brewster's signature vocal hook
Ring out the final E chord into the next section

sections.name: Guitar Solo
sections.description: Rick Brewster's iconic E major pentatonic guitar solo showcasing Australian pub rock lead phrasing

riffAnalysis.technique: Major pentatonic scale patterns with bending

notes: Ascend cleanly through the E major pentatonic scale (E, F#, G#, B, C#)
Notice the sweet major 3rd (G# at 11th fret G string and 11th fret A string)
Sustain the 12th fret root with aggressive rock vibrato
sections.exerciseLabel: Rick Brewster Blistering Gibson SG Solo

guitar.pickup: Humbuckers (bridge for lead, neck for rhythm)

effects.other: None required - focus on natural tube tone
